ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.tip: When an enemy unit enters the slot facing it (played, spawned or moved in), deal 3 damage to it.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.tip: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for N damage every upkeep.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.tip: Every melee hit it lands adds N Bleed.

sweep.name: Cleave
sweep.tip: Also deals 1 damage to the units beside its target.

evasive.name: Evasive
evasive.tip: Dodges half of all single-target attacks and skills.

flying.name: Flying
flying.tip: Dodges half of all attacks from units without Flying.

foraging.name: Foraging
foraging.tip: +1 Berry each turn. 3 Berries heal your most hurt other ally 3.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.tip: Takes the plain attacks aimed at its adjacent allies (not the bramble).

sap.name: Leech
sap.tip: Heals for the damage its hits deal.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.tip: When played: 1 damage to the foe facing it, else one beside it, else the bramble.

shield.name: Shield
shield.tip: Arrives with 1 Shield: temporary Health that soaks damage first.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.tip: +1 Attack for every ally that shares a type with it.

swift.name: Swift
swift.tip: Always attacks first, and dodges half the attacks from units without Swift.

bloomCopy.name: Bloom
bloomCopy.tip: Each Ready round its conditions hold: a copy with +1/+1 grows in an adjacent slot.

harbinger.name: Harbinger
harbinger.tip: Whenever another unit dies, on either side, it gains +1/+1 (up to 3 a round).

inspiring.name: Inspiring
inspiring.tip: Attacking gives adjacent allies N Inspiration: +1 Attack each, spent on their next hit.

pack.name: Pack
pack.tip: Pack units of its type side by side each get +1/+1 per Pack point in the chain.

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.tip: Its melee hits ignore N Armor.

recoil.name: Recoil
recoil.tip: Each attack also deals N damage to itself.

twinShot.name: Twin Shot
twinShot.tip: While Ready, shoot two random enemy units for 2 damage each every upkeep.

keenSense.name: Keen Sense
keenSense.tip: Darkness and Blind don't make it miss grounded units; it can't be Blinded.

acid.name: Acid
acid.tip: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 acid damage and 1 Corrode to the foe facing it (or nearest).

bola.name: Bola
bola.tip: Each Ready round: a 1-damage bola; the unit hit is Pinned next turn (no swing, move or dodge).

boomerang.name: Boomerang
boomerang.tip: Its throw comes back next round and hits the same target again. Catch it!

crabClaws.name: Crab Claws
crabClaws.tip: Pinches a random enemy to its left or right, never the one in front; with none, the bramble.

bludgeon.name: Bludgeon
bludgeon.tip: Its hits take 1 Attack and knock out one of the target's skills.

brood.name: Brood
brood.tip: When it arrives, a 1/1 copy of it (Wait 1, every skill but Brood) hatches beside it.

crit.name: Crit
crit.tip: Each round, a 1-in-2 chance to deal double damage.

packLeader.name: Pack Leader
packLeader.tip: Links all your Pack units of its type into one chain, side by side or not, and adds +2/+2.

meiosis.name: Meiosis
meiosis.tip: When it dies, it splits into 2 halves: half the stats and skill numbers, no Meiosis.

strangle.name: Strangle/Constrict
strangle.tip: Its hits Bind the target for a round and squeeze it for 2.

trap.name: Trap
trap.tip: When played, trap the empty enemy slot facing it: the next card played there takes 5 damage.

web.name: Web
web.tip: Its hits Web the target for 1 round.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.tip: +N Attack every time it kills a unit.

overwhelm.name: Stampede
overwhelm.tip: Damage left over from a kill carries on into the enemy bramble.

wave.name: Wave
wave.tip: Hits push the target 1 column either way; crashing into a unit deals 1 to both.

smokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokeBomb.tip: Each round, 1 in 2: smoke-bombs a random unit. Allies hide in Smoke; enemies are Blinded.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.tip: While Ready, if nothing faces it, shoot a random enemy unit for 1 every upkeep.

loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.tip: While an ally leader is on the field: +0/+0.

corpsefeeder.name: Corpsefeeder
corpsefeeder.tip: Each turn while Ready, it exiles your oldest graveyard card and gains +1/+1.

dry.name: Dry
dry.tip: Takes half fire damage, and Scorching days can't touch it.

friction.name: Friction
friction.tip: When it attacks, deal N damage to adjacent allies.

iceBolt.name: Ice
iceBolt.tip: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 cold damage to the foe facing it (or nearest), and it Freezes.

ichor.name: Ichor
ichor.tip: Whoever hits it takes N acid damage, loses 1 Armor and Bleeds 1.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.tip: When it dies, deal 1 damage to the enemy facing it and the enemies beside that one (not Flying).

rage.name: Rage
rage.tip: Below half Health: double Attack and takes half damage.

rally.name: Rally
rally.tip: When it enters play, your units on the field gain +1 Attack until the end of the next round.

slow.name: Slow
slow.tip: Acts last among units of the same Speed. Two Slow units take turns as usual.

rainrunner.name: Rainrunner
rainrunner.tip: In rain: +N/+N, and it can't be blocked.

loneWolf.name: Lone Wolf
loneWolf.tip: +0/+0 for each empty slot within 2 of it, and +0/+0 more when all 4 are empty.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.tip: Each time frost chills it, it gains +N/+N for good.

hoard.name: Hoard
hoard.tip: +1 Attack for every 2 Lumber you hold.

isolation.name: Isolation
isolation.tip: A drawback: −4/−4 with no ally within 2 columns, 1 less for each ally nearby.

moonborn.name: Moonborn
moonborn.tip: At night: up to +N/+N, depending on the moon's phase.

mountainClimber.name: Mountain Climber
mountainClimber.tip: Field and terrain hazards pass it by.

sociable.name: Sociable
sociable.tip: +0/+0 for each ally within 2 slots of it, and +0/+0 more when all 4 are filled.

spoils.name: Spoils
spoils.tip: When it kills an enemy creature, it gains +0/+2.

spotter.name: Spotter
spotter.tip: While it lives, your units' attacks, shots and skills can't miss or be dodged.

usurper.name: Usurper
usurper.tip: While the enemy leader is on the field: +0/+0. If it kills the crowned King, it steals the Crown.

siege.name: Siege
siege.tip: Deals 2 more damage to Structures and to the enemy bramble.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.tip: Its hits take 1 Attack from the target for good.

fletcher.name: Fletcher
fletcher.tip: Your units' ranged shots deal 1 more damage.

helmet.name: Helmet
helmet.tip: Half the shots aimed at it glance off, once; then the helmet is gone.

pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
pitchfork.tip: One four-pronged swing, aimed left or right at random: half Attack on each of 4 neighbouring columns.

scare.name: Scare
scare.tip: Attacks against it deal N less damage.

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.tip: Every heal on your units heals 1 more.

perforate.name: Perforate
perforate.tip: Its melee hits ignore and strip N Armor, add N Bleed and deal N damage to the enemy bramble.

pulverise.name: Pulverise
pulverise.tip: Ignores Armor, double damage to Structures. A landed swing breaks the target's Armor, Magic Armor and equipment.

puncture.name: Puncture
puncture.tip: Each melee hit also deals N damage to the enemy bramble.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.tip: Its hits steal 1 of the target's tokens; on the bramble, 1 of its lowest-ranked resource.

broodkeeper.name: Broodkeeper
broodkeeper.tip: Your units made by abilities arrive with +1/+1.

hunter.name: Cull
hunter.tip: Its hits and shots deal 1 more to weak units (Attack 2 or less, Health 4 or less).

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.tip: Its hits and shots deal 1 more to units below a quarter of their Health.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.tip: Its hits double the Bleed the target already has.

petrify.name: Petrify
petrify.tip: Its attacks turn the target to stone for a round.

predator.name: Predator
predator.tip: Deals 1 more damage to units with less Attack.

prey.name: Prey
prey.tip: Evasive while an enemy Predator is on the field.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.tip: Deals extra damage equal to its own Bleed.

silence.name: Silence
silence.tip: Its attacks Silence the target for 2 rounds.

stench.name: Stench
stench.tip: When played, 1 Stench on the enemy facing it and the units adjacent to that one.

stunOnHit.name: Stun
stunOnHit.tip: Its hits have a 1 in 3 chance to Stun the target for 1 round.

wilting.name: Wilting
wilting.tip: Each time it is hit, it loses 1 Attack for good.

wither.name: Wither
wither.tip: Its hits wither: -N max Health a round for 3 rounds, and no healing meanwhile.

exploit.name: Exploit
exploit.tip: Its hits put 2 Exploit tokens on the target: each later hit on it deals 1 more.

fork.name: Fork
fork.tip: Strikes up to 2 adjacent enemies in front of this unit

expose.name: Expose
expose.tip: Its hits strip the target's hiding for 2 rounds: Invisible, Evasive, Smoke and Shadow stop working.

banana.name: Banana
banana.tip: Each round, last: eats its banana (+3 Health, if hurt) or throws it at a random enemy (3 damage).

chilli.name: Chilli
chilli.tip: When first Ready: +2 Attack and fire attacks, but it takes 1 damage every upkeep.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.tip: Every 2 turns: acts twice, then Stunned for a round.

durian.name: Durian
durian.tip: Every round, last: 1 in 2 it eats a durian for Thorns +1 (stacks).

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.tip: Its hits shove a Ready target back: +1 Wait.

rebuild.name: Rebuild
rebuild.tip: While Ready, restore 2 Health to your bramble every upkeep.

trident.name: Trident
trident.tip: One three-pronged swing straight ahead: full Attack in front, half to the units on its left and right.

herald.name: Herald
herald.tip: Your Leader has {+N/+N} while it lives.

molting.name: Molting
molting.tip: Every 2 rounds: +1/+1 for good, but +1 Wait.

octolash.name: Octolash
octolash.tip: Hits the 8 nearest enemy units with full Attack.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.tip: Enemies facing it or beside that column must attack it.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.tip: While it has any status, it attacks twice and each hit adds 1 Bleed.

lasso.name: Lasso
lasso.tip: Once when Ready: a 1-damage lasso; it and its target are tied (no swing or move) until one dies.

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.tip: Takes half (rounded up) of each hit on your bramble from its column or beside it.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.tip: Shots aimed at it (arrows, bolts, missiles, fireballs) bounce off and hit a random enemy unit.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.tip: Its hits destroy 1 of the opponent's resources, lowest rank first.

scavenge.name: Scavenge
scavenge.tip: When a surrounding unit dies, +1 scavenge points. Every 3 points: 1 Lumber.

shockBolt.name: Spark
shockBolt.tip: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 lightning damage to the foe facing it (or nearest), and Shocks it.

sprout.name: Sprout
sprout.tip: When it arrives, a 1/3 Growth Sprout sprouts beside it.

dropRoll.name: Stop, Drop and Roll
dropRoll.tip: When it would catch fire it rolls instead: no Burn, but Wait +1.

dirgeGrant.name: Dirge
dirgeGrant.comment: (Explicit remove, and similar remove all other duplicates)

fragile.name: Fragile
fragile.comment: (like Brittle, however this is more 'generic' in flavour - better)

charge.name: Charge
charge.tip: Once Ready, a clock counts down each upkeep; at 0 its effect happens and the clock restarts.

arrowFlaming.name: Fire Arrow
arrowFlaming.tip: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for N fire damage every upkeep.

repair.name: Repair
repair.comment: (Same as Rebuild but for structures. Not sure about this one)
repair.tip: Each turn, repairs the most damaged nearby structure for 2; with none, your bramble for 1.

shell.name: Shell
shell.tip: Each round, when first hit: +N Armor until the round ends.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.tip: When played, deal N lightning damage to a random enemy unit, +1 for every 4 Prayer (none to a bramble: it can't be shocked).

cure.name: Cure
cure.tip: Every upkeep, cure up to 2 Venom from your most envenomed unit. Venom only.

nursing.name: Nursing
nursing.comment: 1 (I think we'll use this instead of "Heal". And the action of Heal will be called "Nurse".)
nursing.tip: Heal your weakest wounded unit for 2 every upkeep.

deliveryEvery.name: Delivery, every turn
deliveryEvery.comment: 1 (The aciton version of this is just called Every Turn, Deliver)

electricity.name: Electricity
electricity.comment: 1 (To me, Electricity and Electric type attacks count as 1 skill. Same as Venom type and Venomous.)
electricity.tip: Its hits arc to a unit adjacent to the target for 1 lightning damage.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.comment: 1 (We need to find an alternate use. Don't give diurnal units anything. it isn't the sun!)
illuminate.tip: Lights up the dark: your units don't miss in darkness, and nor does the enemy unit facing it.

dynamite.name: Dynamite
dynamite.comment: 1A (Same as 1, but mainly to represent the 'civilised society' animals)
dynamite.tip: A 3-upkeep fuse; at 0 it blows: 5 fire damage to every surrounding unit.

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.comment: 2 (Brittle should be the name of the status effect, but to make brittle - a new skill name)
brittle.tip: Its hits make the target Brittle for a round.

daunt.name: Daunt
daunt.tip: On every melee hit it lands, the target loses N Attack until the end of next round. Stacks.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.tip: As it arrives it builds 1 × Log Wall (0/8 each) in the free front-row slots nearest it.

esprit.name: Esprit
esprit.tip: +0/+0 whenever another of your Kin enters play.

fencing.name: Fencing
fencing.tip: Its attacks can't be dodged by Evasive or Swift units.

counterattack.name: Counterattack
counterattack.comment: 3 (Counterattackers don't attack on their own. Unless there isn't an opposing enemy in its range, then it would attack the opposing bramble)
counterattack.tip: Never attacks on its own. Each time an enemy hits it, it strikes the enemy facing it.

brambleArmor.name: Fortify (Armor 1), while it lives
brambleArmor.tip: Your bramble takes 1 less damage from each hit.

offspring.name: Offspring
offspring.tip: When it arrives, 1 copies hatch beside it: half its Attack and Health (rounded down), Wait 1, no Offspring.

fullMoon.name: Full Moon
fullMoon.tip: The first full moon over it: +3/+3 for the rest of the fight.

fog.name: Fog
fog.comment: 4 (The thing after the colon is the default. However, Fog should be a field tracker, not the skill name -> field tracker are like sun and tide. Field effects grant field effects. It would just write "Fog" in a pill)

warcry.name: Warcry
warcry.tip: When played, your other units get +1/+1.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.comment: 5 (Means payoff for a Rating-1 mechanic + it's not interesting enough to be a 3)
detonate.tip: Its hits make the target's Venom tick 1 times at once, each tick taking a counter off.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.comment: 5 (Param 1: 3 types: Copy Attack, Copy Defence, Copy N Skills of Param 2 <Target>)
mimic.tip: When it enters play, it copies a random ally: its skills, and the higher of each stat.

greaterPoison.name: Deadly Poison
greaterPoison.tip: Its hits turn the target's Venom into Deadly Poison and add 1 Deadly Poison.

exhaust.name: Exhaust
exhaust.comment: 6 (Exhaust, exploit and expose are similar. Giving tactical depth.)
exhaust.tip: Its attacks give the target 2 Exhaust tokens.

stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
stonecutter.comment: 7 (But maybe instead it's every turn, turn 2 lumber into 1 stone)

spawner.name: Spawner
spawner.comment: 7 (Maybe better to use this instead of Every turn -> {Spawn} trigger-action pairs)
spawner.tip: While Ready, it spawns N into the free slot nearest it every turn.

chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
chrysalis.tip: A Stem an Evolute Alpha can be played straight onto. The evolute gains +1/+2.

crystallise.name: Crystallise
crystallise.tip: When it dies, it becomes a 0/5 crystal in its slot.

evolute.name: Evolute
evolute.tip: Play it onto your unit of a shared type: it adds that unit's stats and keeps its statuses.

evoluteAlpha.name: Evolute Alpha
evoluteAlpha.tip: Play it onto your Evolute unit, or a Chrysalis, of a shared type. It adds that unit's stats.

evoluteOmega.name: Evolute Omega
evoluteOmega.tip: Play it onto your Evolute Alpha unit of a shared type. It adds that unit's stats.

hatchling.name: Hatchling
hatchling.tip: An evolute played onto it gains +1/+2. From Level 1.

stem.name: Stem
stem.tip: An evolute played onto it gains +1/+2.

inherentDarkness.name: Inherent Darkness
inherentDarkness.tip: While Ready, gain N Darkness every upkeep.

prayer.name: Prayer
prayer.tip: Gains 1 📿 Prayer a turn as tokens; they go if it leaves the field.

prayerWard.name: Prayer Ward
prayerWard.tip: Armor 1 while it holds Prayer tokens.

remember.name: Remember
remember.tip: In your Removal Zone: at upkeep, spend N Echoes to return with +N/+N.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.tip: A Dark Summon played onto it costs N less, and this unit perishes.

worship.name: Worship
worship.tip: +1 Attack for every 3 Prayer you have.

kinglyGrant.name: King
kinglyGrant.tip: The first King in play takes the Crown. While it holds it: n.

kingSlayer.name: King Slayer
kingSlayer.tip: Deals 1 bonus damage on every hit against Royalty, a King or the crowned unit or a leader.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.tip: Normal attacks pass through it; other elements deal half, magic full. It can't Bleed.

immolation.name: Immolation
immolation.tip: Every upkeep: N fire damage to adjacent units and the enemy facing it.

nova.name: Nova
nova.tip: When it dies, every enemy unit takes 3 magic damage.

nullify.name: Nullify
nullify.tip: Its hits trigger no reactions. Units it kills skip their death effects and go to the Removal Zone.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.tip: Its hits also deal 1 psychic damage, through Armor, Shield, Shell and Ghost. Elementals and Plants are immune.

shade.name: Shade
shade.tip: At night or in darkness: half damage from non-magic attacks.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.tip: At night or in darkness: attacks at it miss 1 in 2 (not magic).

socket.name: Socket
socket.tip: Each copy has 1 more gem socket(s).

keenEye.name: True Sight
keenEye.tip: Sees and hits Invisible units; reveals fog.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.tip: Each turn while Ready, turns 2 Lumber and 2 Stone into 1 Metal, if you have them.

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lumberjack.tip: Whenever you gain Lumber, gain 1 more.

absoluteZero.name: Absolute Zero
absoluteZero.tip: When played, every enemy unit is Frozen for the round.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.tip: When it arrives, every enemy unit without Flying takes N cold damage and +1 Wait.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.tip: When played, deal N damage to every other unit without Flying, yours included.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.tip: When Ready: a fireball hits a random enemy unit and the units beside it for 15 fire damage each.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.tip: When Ready: a meteor hits a random enemy column for 20 (5 beside it); the crater burns 2 rounds.

poisonGas.name: Poison Gas
poisonGas.tip: When played, every enemy unit gets 2 Venom.

venomPulse.name: Pulse
venomPulse.tip: Its hits make the target's Venom and Bleed tick once more, at once.

rainmaker.name: Rainmaker
rainmaker.tip: When played, Spring Rain falls for 3 rounds (every unit heals 2 a round).

skyfall.name: Skyfall
skyfall.tip: When played, deal N damage to a random enemy unit, or the bramble if there are no targets.

slashBurn.name: Slash & Burn
slashBurn.tip: When it kills a unit, the next enemy card played there takes 3 fire damage.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.tip: When it arrives, a random enemy unit is flung to another column for 1 damage (2 for flyers).

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.tip: When it arrives, every enemy unit gets +1 Wait; non-swimmers take N water damage. Starts the Tide.

volley.name: Volley
volley.comment: S (Same as arrow but hits all opposing units, is also an action.
volley.tip: While Ready, every other upkeep, shoot every enemy unit for 1 damage.

chainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
chainLightning.comment: S (Then create a new skill called Bioelectric for normal purposes, as 1.)
chainLightning.tip: Its hits chain lightning on through 2 more enemy units adjacent to the target, 2 lightning damage each.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.tip: On play, takes the enemy's nearest lying weapon; its hits take a unit's weapon. Not if it has one.

anadromous.name: Anadromous
anadromous.tip: Tide map: salt water +1/+1 and Tide; fresh water leaves a Tide Fry at death. No Tide: +0/+1.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.tip: When an enemy enters one of the 3 slots facing it, deal 2 damage to it.

amore.name: Amore
amore.tip: Arriving with another of your Amore units of its Type, both fall in love: +0/+3 and Regeneration 3.

amplifier.name: Amplifier
amplifier.tip: Its adjacent allies have +1 on each skill number, up to +2.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.tip: Nothing can move it: no push, pull, swap, Wave, Tornado or Restless step.

arson.name: Arson
arson.tip: Its hits burn 1 of the opponent's Lumber.

atheist.name: Atheist
atheist.tip: Half damage from magic, Devilry and Ecclesia. Immune to the Leylines.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.tip: Attacks the nearest enemy unit, never the bramble. +2 damage when that unit is worse at combat.

bananarang.name: Bananarang
bananarang.tip: A Boomerang that may be eaten when it comes home (+3 Health, 1 in 2, only if hurt).

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.tip: +N Attack whenever one of your units dies.

bloodTithe.name: Blood Tithe
bloodTithe.tip: When played, deal 2 damage to a random ally (your bramble if there is none).

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.tip: After killing the foe facing it, it leaps to the nearest enemy. Half damage to Structures and brambles.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.tip: Heal a random wounded ally for N every upkeep.

bloomWhen.name: Bloom When
bloomWhen.tip: In bloom 🌸 while its conditions hold: it has the bonus.

fortification.name: Build
fortification.tip: On play, builds a 0/6 Palisade, a Structure, in an empty slot beside it.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.tip: Shares a type with every unit. The enemy sees it in disguise.

fireBolt.name: Cinder
fireBolt.tip: While Ready, spit fire at the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for 2 fire damage every upkeep.

converge.name: Converge
converge.tip: When it becomes Ready, the enemy's units close their gaps toward the centre.

cower.name: Cower
cower.tip: Hit last turn: it hides in its shell this turn (no attack, attacks can't hurt it).

creative.name: Creative
creative.tip: While Ready, give 1 Creativity to a random ally every upkeep.

crepuscular.name: Crepuscular
crepuscular.tip: By day: +0/+0. At night: +0/+0. Twilight brings both.

defiance.name: Defiance
defiance.tip: +1 Attack for every enemy unit that is of its chosen type.

desecrate.name: Desecrate
desecrate.tip: Its hits curse the ground: whoever stands there takes N damage every upkeep. Stacks.

dictator.name: Dictator
dictator.tip: Can only be your Leader. It never goes in your deck.

diurnalGrant.name: Diurnal
diurnalGrant.tip: By day it has n instead of a plain bonus.

dragonLightning.name: Dragon Lightning
dragonLightning.tip: Its hits call red lightning: N damage to the target and a unit adjacent to it, ignoring Armor.

fastForward.name: Fast Forward
fastForward.tip: Takes N extra turns when it arrives.

fieldBreaker.name: Field Breaker
fieldBreaker.tip: When played, the field's round effects stop for 2 rounds.

formation.name: Formation
formation.tip: +1/+1 for each adjacent ally, up to 2.

fullMoonGrant.name: Full Moon
fullMoonGrant.tip: The first full moon over it: n for the rest of the fight.

gash.name: Gash
gash.tip: When played, add N Bleed to the enemy facing it.

glean.name: Glean
glean.tip: Each turn while Ready, it takes every Berry on the board, both sides, and gains +1 Shield for each.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.tip: Half its swings harvest 1 Lumber instead. With nothing opposite, it always harvests.

healing.name: Healing
healing.tip: Every upkeep, heal your most wounded unit for 1. It heals Health only.

heavyMetal.name: Heavy Metal
heavyMetal.tip: Whenever you gain Stone or Metal, gain 1 more.

hiveMind.name: Hive Mind
hiveMind.tip: When it dies, your newest Swarm ally gets +1/+1.

iceArrow.name: Ice Arrow
iceArrow.tip: While Ready, every upkeep: shoots 2 cold damage at the foe facing it (or nearest), and it Freezes.

injured.name: Injured
injured.tip: Comes into play with 1 damage already on it (at least 1 Health left). It can be healed.

invincible.name: Invincible
invincible.tip: Takes no damage for its first 1 round.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.tip: Can't be found for its first 2 rounds, or until it attacks.

irradiated.name: Irradiated
irradiated.tip: Every upkeep: gives N Irradiation to adjacent units and the enemy facing it, and 1 to itself.

kinRally.name: Kin Rally
kinRally.tip: When you play one of its Kin, that unit gets +1/+1.

king.name: King
king.tip: The first King in play takes the Crown. While it holds it: 🪙 Tribute, 🛡 Armor 2.

kinship.name: Kinship
kinship.tip: All your units of its chosen type get +X/+Y (itself too). Stacks.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.tip: Lights up the dark: your units don't miss in darkness.

festering.name: Lingering
festering.tip: While it's on the field, Bleed and Venom don't wear off.

lumberFeast.name: Lumber Feast
lumberFeast.tip: As it arrives it eats up to 3 of your Lumber: +1/+1 for each one.

midas.name: Midas Touch
midas.tip: When it kills a unit, gain N Lumber.

milling.name: Milling
milling.tip: Each turn while Ready, 1 of your Lumber becomes 2. It still attacks.

moonpull.name: Moonpull
moonpull.tip: When it arrives, the Tide comes in.

mulligan.name: Mulligan
mulligan.tip: In your opening hand, it shuffles back into your deck and you draw a card.

nightblind.name: Night-blind
nightblind.tip: Blind at night, unless an Illuminate unit lights your side (or faces it).

nocturnalGrant.name: Nocturnal
nocturnalGrant.tip: At night it has n instead of a plain bonus.

packHowl.name: Pack Howl
packHowl.tip: When you play a Wolf, the enemy facing it Bleeds 1.

penance.name: Penance
penance.tip: When played, deal 3 damage to your own bramble.

poisonous.name: Poisonous
poisonous.tip: When an enemy unit kills it, or a unit devours it, that unit gets 2 Venom.

primed.name: Primed
primed.tip: Its triggers work even while Waiting, Stunned, Frozen or Asleep.

proliferate.name: Proliferate
proliferate.tip: Each round, an Envenomed enemy passes 1 Venom to a unit adjacent to it.

pry.name: Pry
pry.tip: Its hits strip 1 Armor for good.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.tip: Each turn while Ready, pay 1 Lumber to gain 1 Stone. Can't pay: nothing happens.

quick.name: Quick
quick.tip: Swings at Speed 2: before Arrows and Bolts and units without Quick.

rabid.name: Rabid
rabid.tip: Its hits add 2 Venom. Swimmers and water damage hit it for double.

relic.name: Relic
relic.tip: When it dies, leaves a 1/1 Relic in its slot with its plain keywords.

reload.name: Reload
reload.tip: After attacking, sits out N rounds.

restless.name: Restless
restless.tip: Every upkeep it steps one column toward the nearest enemy.

retribution.name: Retribution
retribution.tip: When one of your units dies, deal N damage to a random enemy unit.

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.tip: Once, when Ready: 1 fire damage to the strongest enemy and 1 to its neighbours (or the bramble).

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.tip: When a surrounding structure dies, +1 salvage points. Every 3 points: 1 Stone.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.tip: Its hits and shots deal 2 more to Frozen, Brittle, Petrified or heavily armored units.

shedding.name: Shedding
shedding.tip: Every 3 rounds: +1/+1 for good, and it sheds its Venom, Bleed, Corrode, Scar and Exposed.

shieldCall.name: Shield Call
shieldCall.tip: Once a battle, the first enemy skill aimed at one of your units hits a 0/10 Guardian shield instead.

shieldwall.name: Shieldwall
shieldwall.tip: Its adjacent allies have +1 Armor while it lives.

shoreUp.name: Shore Up
shoreUp.tip: When it is hit and survives, the allies beside it gain Shield 1.

sonar.name: Sonar
sonar.tip: Never misses from Darkness, Blind, Smoke or Fog, and can't be Blinded.

speed.name: Speed
speed.tip: Speed N: faster units swing first.

spellward.name: Spellward
spellward.tip: Single-target skills aimed at an adjacent ally hit this unit instead.

spiteful.name: Spiteful
spiteful.tip: Deal N damage back to any enemy that damages it.

spitfire.name: Spitfire
spitfire.tip: Every upkeep while Ready: 2 fire damage to a random enemy; half the time, 1 to an adjacent unit.

stemGrant.name: Stem
stemGrant.tip: An evolute played onto it gains n.

stymie.name: Stymie
stymie.tip: Its attacks Stymie the target for 2 rounds.

supreme.name: Supreme
supreme.tip: Its attacks are magic and crush Armor, shields and Ward. Takes half from non-magic damage.

supremeTide.name: Supreme Tide
supremeTide.tip: A Tide unit: +2 Attack and +2 Armor every round, Flood or Ebb. Tide effects can't take them away.

swimmer.name: Swimmer
swimmer.tip: On Tide, +1 Attack, +1 Attack. On Ebb, +1 Armor.

tangle.name: Tangleweed
tangle.tip: Its hits Bind the target: it can't attack for 1 round.

tideGrant.name: Tide
tideGrant.tip: On Flood and on Ebb it has the skills in its braces; at High Tide, both.

toxin.name: Toxin
toxin.tip: Its hits add 1 Toxin: a poison that never wears off and can't be cured.

tribute.name: Tribute
tribute.tip: Gains 1 Gold each turn while Ready.

twin.name: Twin
twin.tip: When it arrives, a twin token of it appears beside it.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.tip: Starts in your opening hand (a random card is discarded for it). As your first card this game: +1/+1.

venomMaster.name: Venom Master
venomMaster.tip: Your units' Venom and Bleed hits add 1 more.

poisonBolt.name: Venom Spit
poisonBolt.tip: While Ready, spit venom at the enemy facing it (or the nearest): 2 Venom every upkeep.

poison.name: Venomous
poison.tip: Every melee hit it lands adds N Venom.

venomous.name: Venomous (old)
venomous.tip: Every melee hit it lands adds 2 Venom.

wakeful.name: Wakeful
wakeful.tip: It never falls Asleep: no Sleep hit and no Spore Cloud puts it to sleep.

banner.name: War Banner
banner.tip: Your other units have +1 Attack while it lives.

weaponMaster.name: Weapon Master
weaponMaster.tip: Your side's ranged shots deal 1 more; your equipped units get +1/+1.

satiety.name: Well Fed
satiety.tip: At full Health, gains +N max Health every upkeep.
